# Predicate truth table — explicitly recorded, not derived
#
# R6 requires the outcome per combination to be stated here instead of only
# compared against each other: two identically broken predicates agree with
# each other and would pass a plain equality test.
#
# Every project is fresh and has no WORKFLOW-ADOPTIE.md, so every applicable
# entry is also open. That gives, per predicate, at least one case where it is
# true *and* unanswered — exactly the branch the real adopters' baseline
# misses (see test/fixtures/baseline/LEESMIJ.md).
#
# has-check-command (#248) is independent of package.json — an executable
# `check` at the project root, any stack — not derived from it, even though
# package-json-based fixtures below also carry one for the common case.
#
